hero.heading: Hello, I'm Emz 👋
paragraphs: I design, evolve, and improve web products, mainly for startups and SaaS companies. With more than four years of professional experience, I own features end-to-end, from the initial product need through production delivery: Rails and PostgreSQL backends, JavaScript interfaces, external integrations, and background processing.

Comfortable working in small teams with a high level of ownership, I combine product development, problem-solving, and a strong design and UX/UI sensibility. I notably designed and shipped a complex multilingual video editor from scratch, covering everything from data architecture to the user interface.

I am open to joining a product team long term or working with clients on Rails applications: evolution and maintenance, feature development, integrations, production debugging, and existing codebases.
Based in France · Remote across France, Europe, or internationally

featured.title: DRIME — Multilingual video editor
featured.description: I designed and built from scratch an editor for creating and publishing multilingual videos from a single source project. The interface brings together sequences, text, translations, subtitles and voice-over, with asynchronous processing through publication.
featured.stack: Ruby on Rails · PostgreSQL · JavaScript · Sidekiq / Redis · AWS S3 · Azure APIs

caseStudy.workflow: The main product challenge was making a workflow involving multiple languages, media and processing states understandable.
caseStudy.architectureText: Long-running operations ran in the background with Sidekiq and Redis, media were stored on AWS S3, and translations and voice-over were generated using Azure APIs.

caseStudy.actionLabel: View the DRIME case study — Multilingual video editor
caseStudy.label: Product case study
caseStudy.title: DRIME — Multilingual video editor
caseStudy.intro: An editor designed to turn a single source project into multiple language versions, from preparing sequences to previewing and publishing.

sections.title: The need
sections.text: Producing multiple versions of the same video required coordinating text, subtitles, translations, voice-over and media files. The goal was to bring this workflow together in an understandable interface, without rebuilding each version separately.

sections.title: My role
sections.text: I defined the architecture and developed the backend and frontend. I designed the editing interactions, connected translation and speech synthesis services, organized file storage and implemented the asynchronous processing required for long-running operations.

sections.title: Outcome
sections.text: The editor was delivered to production and enabled users to create and publish multilingual videos in minutes from a single source project. The work covered architecture, the editing experience, external integrations and CI/CD delivery.
